summary.text: Chris Larson is a Democratic member of the Wisconsin State Senate who has represented District 7 since January 2011 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He served as Senate Minority Leader from 2013 to 2015.

paragraphs.text: Chris Larson is a lifelong Wisconsinite who earned a B.A. in finance from the University of Wisconsin-Milwaukee.
He managed a sporting goods store before being elected Milwaukee County Supervisor in 2008, a position he held until his election to the Senate.
In the 2025-2026 session, Larson was assigned to the Senate Education Committee and the Universities and Technical Colleges Committee.
